fine_lines.title: taken aback vs pleasantly surprised
fine_lines.explanation_ar: taken aback = متفاجئ بشكل سلبي غالبًا (صُدم). pleasantly surprised = متفاجئ بشكل إيجابي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Taken aback" = surprised, usually in a negative way (shocked). "Pleasantly surprised" = surprised in a good way.

examples.sentence: I was taken aback by the job cuts.
I was pleasantly surprised by the food.

fine_lines.title: on the point of vs turn out to be
fine_lines.explanation_ar: on the point of + ing = على وشك أن تفعل شيئًا. turn out to be = تبيّن في النهاية أنه كذا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "On the point of + -ing" = just about to do something. "Turn out to be" = finally be shown to be.

examples.sentence: I was on the point of calling you.
The weather turned out to be great.

expressions.meaning_ar: يعتبر الشيء أمرًا مسلّمًا به (ولا يقدّره)
expressions.meaning_en: Expect something will always be there and not value it.
expressions.example: We shouldn't take our parents for granted.
The next months will be hard. Having said that, sales have been good.

expressions.meaning_en: Have an idea or plan already.
expressions.example: Let's go out on Saturday. — Do you have something in mind?

expressions.meaning_en: Be just about to do something.
expressions.example: I was just on the point of leaving when he knocked.
Can you keep an eye on the soup? Don't let it boil over.
It's by no means certain that I'll get the promotion.

expressions.meaning_en: Be found to be, in the end (often a surprise).
expressions.example: The meal turned out to be delicious.

expressions.meaning_en: Says the truth is different from what most people think.
expressions.example: Contrary to popular belief, I can actually cook quite well.

expressions.meaning_en: Be surprised, usually in a negative way.
expressions.example: I was taken aback by their reaction.
Please keep in touch, and don't leave it so long next time.

expressions.meaning_en: Says you will contact someone later.
expressions.example: I'll be in touch when I have more news.

expressions.phrase: I won't be going there again in a hurry.
expressions.meaning_ar: لن أذهب إلى هناك ثانية في وقت قريب.
expressions.meaning_en: Says you didn't like a place.
expressions.example: The hotel was awful. I won't be going there again in a hurry.

grammar.title: Expressions followed by -ing: on the point of
grammar.explanation_ar: on the point of تنتهي بحرف الجر of، لذلك يأتي بعدها الفعل بـ ing.
grammar.explanation_en: "On the point of" ends in the preposition "of", so use -ing after it.
examples: I was on the point of calling you.
She was on the point of leaving.
We were on the point of giving up.

grammar.title: Negative use: shouldn't take ... for granted
grammar.explanation_ar: take for granted تُستخدم غالبًا في النفي كنصيحة: We shouldn't take it for granted that... ويمكن وضع الشيء بين take وfor granted.
grammar.explanation_en: "Take for granted" is often used in the negative as advice: We shouldn't take it for granted that... The object goes between "take" and "for granted".
examples: We shouldn't take our health for granted.
Don't take your friends for granted.
We shouldn't take it for granted that prices will fall.

questions.question: "We shouldn't take our parents for granted" means:

questions.explanation_ar: تعني أنه يجب أن نقدّر والدينا ولا نعتبر وجودهم أمرًا مسلّمًا.
questions.explanation_en: It means we should value them.
